page.content:
Xenomorphs, Weyland-Yutani, and space-horror design that redefined the genre.

How Alien connects

  • Creator: Ridley Scott — Ridley Scott directed Alien and later the Prometheus/Covenant prequels.
  • Work: Alien (1979) — Alien (1979) is the film that starts the franchise.
  • Work: Aliens — Aliens is the 1986 sequel that expands the hive.
  • Work: Prometheus — Prometheus is a 2012 prequel in the Alien line.
  • Work: Alien: Covenant — Alien: Covenant continues the prequel path.

What is Alien?

Alien is the science-fiction horror cycle that begins with Ridley Scott's 1979 film: a commercial crew, a company that wants the organism, and a perfect xenomorph designed with H. R. Giger. Later entries add Colonial Marines, a Queen, and the Prometheus/Covenant prequel path.

Key threads lead to Ridley Scott, Alien (1979), Aliens, Prometheus and Alien: Covenant.
